spirit:component.spirit:name: lte_phy_fft
spirit:component.spirit:description: bel_fft is a FFT co-processor written in Verilog that can calculate FFTs with arbitrary radix. It is a hardware implementation of the free software Kiss FFT (Keep it simple, Stupid!) from Mark Borgerding. The target was to allow a simple replacement of the software code with the hardware implementation. Therefore bel_fft comes with a software driver that is compatible to the Kiss FFT routines.
